title: Chapter 1 Creative Destruction

title: Collaborating with the Financial Conduct Authority on testing agentic AI
author: NatWest Group
reference: Sections What AI use case are we testing and What does the testing look like in practice
verified_summary: NatWest describes testing an agentic complaints investigation system that combines multiple data sources and presents summaries for employee approval, with human oversight and performance checks.
limitations: UK example, bank self-report, and testing-stage evidence. It establishes a relevant use case, not independently verified ROI, autonomous resolution, or US compliance.

title: Chatbots in consumer finance
author: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
reference: Limited ability to solve complex problems and Hindering access to timely human intervention
verified_summary: The report identifies weaknesses in recognizing and resolving disputes and in giving customers meaningful access to human help.
limitations: Older chatbot evidence, not a performance evaluation of current tool-using agents. Used to motivate failure tests, not to infer current adoption rates or detailed legal requirements.
